question: Among players with at least 10 goals in 2023-2024, who underperformed their xG by the most (xG minus goals)?
answer:
Among players with at least 10 goals in the 2023-2024 Premier League season, **Darwin Núñez (Liverpool)** underperformed his xG by the most.

**Biggest xG underperformers (xG − goals):**

| Player | Team | Goals | xG | xG − Goals |
|--------|------|-------|-----|-----------|
| **Darwin Núñez** | Liverpool | 11 | 19.19 | **+8.19** |
| Nicolas Jackson | Chelsea | 14 | 19.86 | +5.86 |
| Erling Haaland | Man City | 27 | 31.65 | +4.65 |
| Mohamed Salah | Liverpool | 18 | 21.94 | +3.94 |
| Julián Álvarez | Man City | 11 | 14.37 | +3.37 |

Núñez racked up over 19 xG but converted only 11 goals — a shortfall of roughly 8.2 goals, by far the biggest gap of any double-figure scorer that season. Nicolas Jackson was next (−5.9), with even Erling Haaland notably under his lofty xG (−4.7) despite scoring 27.

args.sql:
SELECT p.player_name, ps.team, ps.goals_pss, ps.xg_pss,
       (ps.xg_pss - ps.goals_pss) AS xg_minus_goals
FROM vw_player_season_summary ps
JOIN players p ON p.player_id = ps.player_id
WHERE ps.season = '2023-2024' AND ps.league_code = 'ENG-PL'
  AND ps.goals_pss >= 10
ORDER BY xg_minus_goals DESC
LIMIT 10;
